description.description of test case: Free-length variant of passive_anisotropic: 0D fixed_length = 0, the ends are closed by lids that carry the cavity pressure (genet23 Eqs. 39-44), and the tube is 6 times as long (6 L0 = 342.6 mm). The 3D model is closed by an end plate (cylinder_3d.py, closed_end) and compared at mid-length. Quasi-static passive inflation of a thick-walled cylinder (ChamberCylinder) with one circumferential fiber family (helix angle 0): cavity pressure ramped from 0 to 120 mmHg (15998.69 Pa) over 1200 s in 24 steps of 50 s (5 mmHg), then held. Holzapfel-Ogden law (svMultiPhysics HolzapfelOgden) reduced to the passive_isotropic wall plus one fiber family: a = 100 kPa, b = 0 (neo-Hookean, mu = a), a_f = 100 kPa, b_f = 1, k = 0 (no tension-compression switch); sheet and fiber-sheet terms off (a_s = a_fs = 0; svMultiPhysics divides by b_s, b_fs, set to 1); ST91 bulk modulus 100 a = 10 MPa. SI units. Source of the matching 3D svMultiPhysics case (cylinder_3d.py).
